definition: to say you are sorry for something
description: In a cottage garden at sunset, with a honey-coloured stone house, tall hollyhocks and a pale blue wooden gate, a young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and muddy navy trousers keeps a hand on his chest and smiles sheepishly. Beside him a brown-and-white spaniel sits by a dug-up flower bed with pansies ripped out and soil everywhere, then jumps up and sits again. A young woman in a green T-shirt and denim shorts stands with her arms crossed, then smiles and points a trowel at the mess.

de.answer: Sie steht mit verschränkten Armen da.
de.question: Wie steht die Frau da?

es.answer: Está de pie con los brazos cruzados.
es.question: ¿Cómo está de pie la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle se tient les bras croisés.
fr.question: Comment la femme se tient-elle ?
